title: Coffee, please
titleJp: コーヒー、お{願|ねが}いします

canDos.text: Order a drink and something to eat for each of you at a café counter.

check.instructions: You're at the counter of a small café with your partner. Using the board below, order out loud: a different drink for each of you and something to eat for each of you. Then thank the clerk.
rubric: Gets the clerk's attention with すみません
Orders two different drinks, e.g. コーヒー、おねがいします。こうちゃもおねがいします。
Orders something to eat for each of you, e.g. ケーキ、ふたつおねがいします
Thanks the clerk with ありがとうございます

canDos.text: Catch prices in yen when a clerk tells you what something costs or what the total is.

check.instructions: Listen to a customer at a bakery café counter. You can play it twice. Then answer the questions about the prices.
check.material:
「すみません、このパンはいくらですか。」
「そのパンは{二百八十円|にひゃくはちじゅうえん}です。」
「じゃあ、それ、ふたつお{願|ねが}いします。コーヒーもお{願|ねが}いします。」
「はい、{九百円|きゅうひゃくえん}です。」
「はい。」
「{百円|ひゃくえん}のお{釣|つ}りです。ありがとうございます。」

questions.q: How much is one of the breads?
How much change does the customer get?

canDos.text: Read a café menu with prices and choose what the two of you can have for 1,000 yen.

check.instructions: You and your partner have 1,000 yen between you. Read the menu board at a café and answer the questions.

questions.q: You want coffee and your partner wants black tea. What can you add and still pay 1,000 yen or less?
options: Nothing: the two drinks already cost more than 1,000 yen

questions.q: Your partner wants a beer and you want a juice. How much is that?

canDos.text: Ask where the toilet is and follow a 'here / there / over there' answer.

check.instructions: Listen to a customer asking a café clerk where things are. You can play it twice. Then answer the questions.
check.material:
「すみません。お{水|みず}はどこですか。」
「お{水|みず}はあそこです。」
「あそこですか。ありがとうございます。あのう、トイレは？」
「トイレですか。すぐそこですよ。」

options: Over there, away from both of them
Behind the counter, by the clerk
Just there, close to the customer
Over there, far from both of them

questions.q: Now you want to ask a clerk where the toilet is. What do you say?
options: すみません、トイレはどれですか。
すみません、トイレはどこですか。
すみません、トイレはいくらですか。

canDos.text: Say what you each drink every day, and react to your food and drinks together with ね and よ.

check.instructions: Your partner (or the app) asks about your drinks, then shares some cake with you. Answer each line out loud in a full sentence.
check.material:
「{朝|あさ}はコーヒーですか、{紅茶|こうちゃ}ですか。」
「コーヒーは{毎日|まいにち}{飲|の}みますか。」
「このケーキ、おいしいですね。」
「この{店|みせ}はパンもおいしいですよ。」
rubric: Says what they drink, using a ます or ません verb at least once (こうちゃはまいにちのみます／コーヒーはのみません)
Agrees about the cake with そうですね or おいしいですね
Reacts to the news about the bread with そうですか or へえ
Adds a fact of their own with よ (e.g. ここはコーヒーもやすいですよ)

task.goal: Order two drinks and one snack to share from the café clerk (played by the AI), spending no more than 1,000 yen.
task.outcomeQuestion: What did you order, and how much did it come to?

roles.a: Reads the menu and does the ordering
roles.b: Holds the 1,000 yen and knows what you both want

task.infoA: You have the menu: コーヒー ¥350, こうちゃ ¥400, ジュース ¥300, ケーキ ¥450, パン ¥250. You always have coffee. You don't know what your partner wants, so ask (コーヒーですか、こうちゃですか？) and tell them the prices they ask about. Then you order at the counter (〜、おねがいします).
task.infoB: You can't see the menu, but you hold the money: exactly 1,000 yen (せんえん). You want black tea (こうちゃ); your partner always has coffee. You'd love to share a piece of cake (ケーキ), but bread (パン) is fine too. Ask what things cost (いくらですか) and make sure the total is 1,000 yen or less.
task.twist: On the repeat, B has only 900 yen (きゅうひゃくえん) and wants juice (ジュース) instead of tea. Work out the order again before you reach the counter.
task.aiRole: Café clerk who greets you, takes your order, tells you the total and gives you your change

scripted.jp: コーヒーですか、{紅茶|こうちゃ}ですか。
{私|わたし}は{紅茶|こうちゃ}です。いくらですか。
scripted.en: I'll have black tea. How much is it?

scripted.jp: {紅茶|こうちゃ}は{四百円|よんひゃくえん}です。コーヒーは{三百五十円|さんびゃくごじゅうえん}です。
scripted.en: The tea is 400 yen. The coffee is 350 yen.

scripted.jp: ケーキは{四百五十円|よんひゃくごじゅうえん}です。ちょっと{高|たか}いですね。
scripted.en: The cake is 450 yen. That's a bit pricey, isn't it?

scripted.jp: そうですね。パンはいくらですか。
scripted.en: It is. How much is the bread?

scripted.jp: {二百五十円|にひゃくごじゅうえん}です。
じゃあ、パンはどうですか。{全部|ぜんぶ}で{千円|せんえん}ですよ。
scripted.en: Then how about the bread? That makes 1,000 yen altogether.

scripted.jp: いいですね。すみません！ コーヒー、お{願|ねが}いします。{紅茶|こうちゃ}もお{願|ねが}いします。
scripted.en: Good idea. Excuse me! A coffee, please. And a black tea, please.

scripted.jp: それから、パン、ひとつお{願|ねが}いします。…はい、{千円|せんえん}です。
scripted.en: And one bread, please. … Here's 1,000 yen.

capstone.title: Our little café
capstone.brief: One of you runs a tiny café and the other drops in for a break; then swap. Greet, order, ask and give prices, react to the taste with ね and よ, and ask where the toilet is.
